question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the academic posts Brown was appointed to at the University of Glasgow (lecturer, senior lecturer, reader, professorial chair or Regius professor), in chronological order.
criterion: Brown is appointed to an academic rank or professorial chair at the University of Glasgow
why_needs_multiple: Five separate promotions or appointments at one university make up the answer set.

gold_events.text: Became lecturer at University of Glasgow.
Promoted to senior lecturer at University of Glasgow.
Became reader at University of Glasgow.
Promoted to chair of astrophysics at University of Glasgow.
Became Regius Professor of Astronomy at University of Glasgow.

question: By calendar year, how many years passed between Brown's appointment as Astronomer Royal for Scotland and his appointment as Regius Professor of Astronomy at the University of Glasgow?
criterion: Two named appointments: Astronomer Royal for Scotland, and Regius Professor of Astronomy at Glasgow
why_needs_multiple: The question asks for the interval between two named appointments, so both dates are needed.

gold_events.text: Became Regius Professor of Astronomy at University of Glasgow.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, summarize the university degrees Brown was awarded, including his BSc, PhD and DSc.
criterion: Brown is awarded an academic degree (first-class BSc, PhD or DSc)

gold_events.text: Earned first class BSc in physics and astronomy, Glasgow.
